gate.none: This repo exposes no web address at all: it is scheduled jobs, command-line subcommands and chat commands. A check keyed on routes fires never, and a check keyed on the whole code tree fires on every change — so neither can tell whether a capability moved. An honest none beats a dead or over-firing check, and the manifest is still validated here.

capabilities.name: booking_robot_health
capabilities.does: Says whether the booking robot can reach the booking service right now.

invoke.note: Run from the ts directory of this repo's checkout on the club machine. There is no build step; everything runs through tsx.

capabilities.name: booking_recommendation_preview
capabilities.does: Works out what the robot would book on a given day and prints it, booking nothing.

invoke.note: Date is in month/day/year form. Nothing is booked and nothing is posted to chat.

examples: What would the robot book next Tuesday?

capabilities.name: standing_session_gaps
capabilities.does: Reports which standing weekly sessions are missing from the next two weeks, and changes nothing.

invoke.note: Without the fix flag this only reports. The flag turns it into a booking action, which is a separate capability.

examples: Are any of our standing sessions missing from the calendar?

capabilities.name: booking_day_run
capabilities.does: Books the robot's picks for one day on the courts.

invoke.note: This is the only writer of court bookings in the operation. It books silently by default.

capabilities.name: standing_session_gap_fix
capabilities.does: Books or widens whatever is missing from the standing weekly sessions in the next two weeks.

invoke.note: The writing half of the gap report. It raises an alarm for whatever it could not fix.

examples: Fill in the standing sessions that are missing.

capabilities.name: booking_catch_up
capabilities.does: Re-books the days in the next two weeks that an earlier run left empty or missed.

invoke.note: Without the book flag it only reports. Scheduled daily, so a hand run is for a day the schedule missed.

examples: Catch up anything the morning run missed.
